steps.label: GARCH: variance is an exact function of past data
steps.sub: no new randomness enters the variance equation

steps.label: SV: volatility has its own separate random shock
steps.sub: a latent process, never directly observed

steps.label: Returns driven by one shock, volatility by another

code:
r_t = sigma_t * z_t,                 z_t ~ N(0, 1)

log(sigma_t^2) = mu
    + phi * (log(sigma_(t-1)^2) - mu)
    + eta_t,                          eta_t ~ N(0, sigma_eta^2)

# z_t drives returns; a SEPARATE shock eta_t drives log-volatility
caption: Volatility follows its own AR(1)-like process in log-space, with its own innovation eta_t.
